one_sentence_story: When Harry Harlow gave infant monkeys one bare wire frame with a milk bottle and one milkless frame wrapped in warm terrycloth, they clung to the soft cloth 17 hours a day — proving love grows from safe touch, not food payouts.
so_what_for_you: Comfort doesn't make children or teams weak; providing a predictable, warm safe base is the exact fuel that lets people step out and explore bravely.
